mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous week-on-week collapse in WORKPLACES (from +2.0 to -26.6) alongside drops in RETAIL_REC, TRANSIT and PARKS signals a broad mobility-suppressing policy event whose effects persist, continuing to depress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact: WORKPLACES fell from +2.0 to -26.6 in one week
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC's mean over the next 28 days exceeds its mean over the last 28 days while WORKPLACES remains below -20, the always-on suppression mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A single-week surge in RESIDENTIAL mobility from 5.4 to 14.7, a 9.3-point jump crossing an 8-point threshold, indicates households sheltering at home, a shift that reduces discretionary retail trips over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises more than 8 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact: RESIDENTIAL rose from 5.4 to 14.7 between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC's 2-week forward mean does not fall below its trailing 2-week mean despite the RESIDENTIAL jump exceeding the threshold, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The joint collapse of TRANSIT (-21.4) and WORKPLACES (-26.6) in the same week removes both the commuting pathway and the destination anchor for retail trips, compounding to suppress RETAIL_REC more than either series alone would predict over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact: both series dropped sharply in the same week (t-0w)
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC's forward 28-day mean is higher than its trailing 28-day mean despite TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both remaining depressed, the compounding interaction is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS mobility stays severely suppressed (below -30) for two consecutive weeks, it signals an active outdoor-activity restriction regime that also curtails adjacent retail and recreation visits, lowering RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS mobility remains below -30 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact: PARKS fell from -22.9 to -37.0 between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS stays below -30 for two weeks but RETAIL_REC's forward mean rises relative to its trailing mean, the regime-conditional link is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A gradual seasonal decline in outdoor activity, reflected in the steady week-on-week drop in PARKS (-11.7, -14.0, -22.9, -37.0), reduces overall out-of-home movement and correlates with a near-term pullback in RETAIL_REC over the following week.
evidence_refs: fact: PARKS declined monotonically across all four weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC's 1-week forward value rises despite PARKS continuing its monotonic decline, the seasonal mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained high GROCERY_PHARM mobility (consistently above +39 across all four weeks) reflects an entrenched essential-shopping-only behavioral pattern that crowds out broader retail and recreation trips, keeping RETAIL_REC suppressed over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact: GROCERY_PHARM stayed above +39 for all four observed weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC's forward 28-day mean exceeds its trailing 28-day mean while GROCERY_PHARM remains elevated above +35, the substitution mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The sharp single-week decline in RETAIL_REC (-13.7, down from -3.7) represents an overshoot shock that triggers a short-term mean-reversion bounce, producing a higher RETAIL_REC value in the immediate following week.
evidence_refs: fact: RETAIL_REC fell 10 points in one week, from -3.7 to -13.7
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC continues to decline or stays flat in the week immediately following the overshoot rather than bouncing upward, the mean-reversion hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The coordinated same-week collapse across TRANSIT, PARKS, and WORKPLACES indicates a multi-channel policy-driven mobility restriction whose combined suppressive effect on RETAIL_REC exceeds what any single channel's decline would predict, over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact: all three series dropped sharply together in the t-0w week
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC's 2-week forward mean does not fall below its trailing mean despite all three channels remaining jointly depressed, the interaction hypothesis is rejected.
